The level backgrounds and the successful music repeat themselves after a few levels, but the enemies are getting faster and faster. Tit Bit can only be played alone, unfortunately a two-player mode is not provided.

182973.overview: Published in Game On 1994/09.  Tit Bit 2 is a single-screen platformer that is about opening a door so you can go to the next level. To achieve this, some items have to be collected. The enemies floating around make this plan difficult. The level backgrounds and the successful music repeat themselves after a few levels, but the enemies are getting faster and faster. Tit Bit 2 can only be played alone, unfortunately a two-player mode is not provided.

182974.overview: A single player space strategy game by Eddy Lorenzon and released in 1985 by Tergestesoft.

182975.overview: Title Bout is an action-based boxing game for two players. Each player can play as a circa 1983 professional boxer, or as a historical great such as Muhammad Ali or Joe Louis. Each boxer has attributes for punching accuracy, defense, endurance, power, control, and others, which affect the outcomes of the matches, along with the fighting strategies you choose to employ.

182989.overview: This game is the first part of the Arlia Trilogy. The second part "Magnar's Tomb" and the third part "The Gold Dragon" appear never to have been released.

182990.overview: Odd split-screen game where you move a rugby-ball around a pyramid.

183237.overview:
The Tomb of Dracula is an arcade adventure where the aim is to explore vaults over various levels of Dracula's Tomb to find the Vampire's Treasure worth half a million pounds. At the start of the game you are presented for a limited time, a map of the first level of 300 vaults showing all the obstacles, monsters and stakes which needs memorising before it disappears. You move about in a North, South, East or West direction which is shown in a 1st person perspective. You are then told what is in that vault every time you move into it.

As well as the empty vaults you will discover there are also zombies and ghouls which will need killing with your limited supply of stakes to move on. Slime pits are there to be fallen into and once again stakes are needed to survive. To help you there are vaults full of stakes because if you don't have enough stakes then it is game over. After 30 minutes of exploring, Dracula himself will wake up and stand in the vault next to you. As you move he will follow and clear the room of any stakes if any are in there. If you walk into a vault containing Dracula then he needs to be killed but he will rise again and place himself next to your vault again.

Occasionally you will be presented with the choice to look at the map again but this will cost you stakes if you choose to look. To move onto the next level, you have to find a staircase and this will also give you extra stakes.

183239.overview: Tombola is a lottery-style board game similar to bingo which originated in Southern Italy. Published as Tombalon in the Italian cassette release Alga Soft 1988 n.14a.

183315.overview: An action game from Elmar Denkmann and Reiner Krosta of Mania-Soft, a German game company, released in 1987. To win you must take the ball through all 12 rooms.

183340.overview: A motorcycle racing game released as part of "Fantastic Four 2" game pack and in Magic Disk 64 1990/06.

183523.overview: The player's task is to reach the bomb and return to the exit, which will appear after it is activated. Activating the bomb converts all enemy creatures into points to be collected. While completing the task, avoid contact between the balloon and moving and stationary elements, as well as lasers. An additional difficulty is the passing of time. Created by Heino Görtz and published in Happy Computer 1987/09.

183524.overview: A public domain, single player, vertically scrolling shooter by Edward T. Hall, released in Stonysoft-PD #1808 in 1986.

183526.overview: Tornado is a simple horizontal scrolling shooter developed by Christian Gubert, and published by Multisoft in 1985.

183527.overview: You are Maithros. You were found dying, weeks ago, by an old, mystic called Mitherful. He used his reviving magics to heal you. In return for his help he asks you to join the monks.

183670.overview:
Commodore Format 1992/03 (Issue #18). Total Eclipse 2: The Sphinx Jinx a reworking of Total Eclipse sharing many of the same locations, using the Freescape system and vector graphics. To eliminate an ancient curse the player must find 12 pieces of the sphinx within two hours, hidden in the underground passages beneath the pyramid. Except of numerous puzzles the player will face mummies, poisoned darts or heat exhaustion caused by limited access to the water supply. No objects may be collected, although encountered gold bars can significantly enlarge the assets.
also including an A2 colour poster

183671.overview: A mercenary must get through a series of checkpoints shooting anyone that stands in his way. To do this, he must cross rivers and make his way through forests and villages. Items can be collected for extra points. If the mercenary comes into contact with any of the enemies, he loses a life; and if all his lives are lost, he then retires. Tottem was programmed using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit.

183672.overview: A cycling game published by GO64! 2005/08 and GO64! 2005/10.

183673.overview: A shooter created by Bombjack Ltd. on the foundation of the Shoot'em Up Construction Kit made by Chris Yates. The goal is to make it to the top of the tower.

183674.overview: A platform game created by Alexander Kirsch and Ingo Wolf  and released in both Golden Disk 64 #09 (1990), and in Golden Disk 64 - Gold Edition. In the "Tower of Terror" even fearless players are taught to fear! Fight knights and terrible monsters in 4 levels!

183691.overview:
Towering Inferno is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls firemen with a net at the bottom of a burning building. The player moves laterally to catch falling residents, but residents often bounce, so must be caught several times before being safety caught. Obese residents can not be safely caught, and must be allowed to fall to their death. The player receives bonus points for catching furniture. Some residents burn up in mid-air. If the player misses too many residents, or accidentally catches an obese resident, they lose a life. There are 2 levels of difficulty, and 5 stages.

183692.overview: Toxic is a side scrolling platform game, in the style of Bobix. The aim of the player is to get all the sacks scattered around the level and get to the final exit chamber. Then escape is possible only after gathering all 180 sacks. The action takes place in a city and it's sewers, inhabited by alien creatures. The only way to avoid them is proper use of jumping skills and selecting safe paths. Access to closed areas requires finding the right lever.

183737.overview: Here's an unusual one: The Toy Shop is a set of computerized patterns for building your own mechanical models. You use the software to print out the pieces, then assemble them according to a set of instructions that come with the software. There are 20 different models, including trucks and cars with wheels that turn, a crane, an oil pump, a balloon-powered locomotive, a penny-powered clockwork bank, a helicopter powered by a rubber band, a sundial, a carousel, and the Spirit of St. Louis airplane with a working propeller. Designs can be printed on regular computer paper, then glued to card stock, cut out, and assembled.

183738.overview: A brain - puzzle game developed by ABC Development and published in Magic Disk 64 1992/02.

183739.overview: An action puzzle game from Jan Schulze and first released at the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2014.

183798.overview: Trail West is a game about the American Gold Rush. The player has to move 2000 miles westwards and must try to manage his resources such as food, ammunition, clothes, supplies and reserves. Each turn the player can play a mini-game which influences the reserves such as hunting and traveling. Sold as part of the Micro-Dozen One a compilation of 12 educational titles from Micro-Ed Inc.

183799.overview: Adapted for home computers by designers of systems for major railroads. Train Dispatcher faithfully simulates operations in a railroad traffic control center. In an accelerated 8 hour shift you must move up to 12 trains in both directions through a 150 mile territory - throwing switches and clearing signals to keep the trains on schedule.

183800.overview: A train management game released as part of both the "Crazy Corners" and the "Arcade Action" game packs.

183802.overview: The object of this game by Clive Emberey and published in Your 64 No.05 1984/12-1985/01 is to operate the points of a railway network. You have to keep an increasing number of trains on the move without any of them derailing or colliding. As an added problem, some of the points will (of course) fail and close themselves down for repairs. Trains is a game calling for both strategy and fast reactions.

183803.overview: A strategy trading game. You are the manager of a shipping line for 100 days - Congratulations! Your mission is to earn as much money as you can. You have 5 ships which start in London. You earn money by buying goods at one port and selling at another for a higher price on 8 different products. Furthermore, you are able to accept limited time contracts toward that end. Keep an eye and an ear out for telex messages about storms, contracts and other issues.

183804.overview:
A logic based puzzle game developed by Cream Software and published by CP Verlag in Magic Disk 64 1992/11. In this game a lot of brainpower is required. In addition, you have to prove yourself to be a true joystick acrobat in order to be able to adhere to the really tight time limits.
The aim of the game is to bring order into a completely disorganized ball system. For this reason, the screen is also split in half. The left side represents the desired side and the right side the actual chaos. With the cursor you can now try to move the balls so that both sides are identical. When this is done, a quick press of the space button is enough to get to the next level.
In addition, the status line at the top of the screen provides constant information on the most important data. Above all, you should keep an eye on the time limit and act accordingly.

183805.overview: Published in Game On 1990/1, this is a 2 Player-Only game for simultaneous play written originally in German with English unofficially added.

183806.overview: The sequel to Slap N Tickle. Tragic, mutant, genetic freak, Matthew Slim has found the long lost circuit board. Now you must help our hero to find the Transputer of Learning as only this can free him from the nightmare of being the Transputer Man. This game was one of the samples included in the 1988 release of the Shoot 'Em-Up Construction Kit.

183807.overview:
This release is a new edition of Transylvania, featuring redrawn high-resolution graphics, new locations and puzzles, and new packaging with the Polarware label. Your search begins when the clock strikes midnight.
The King has drafted you to find and rescue his daughter, Princess Sabrina. The Princess is in the clutches of the murderous Vampire who terrorizes the Transylvanian forests. If you fail to rescue the Princess by the final stroke of 5 a.m., she will never again be seen by the living.
To succeed, however, you must match wits with the Werewolf, discover what lays hidden in the Vampire's castle, brave the horrors of the Transylvanian forests, and much more. Hurry now.

Waste no time... lest Sabrina perishes because of your sluggishness!

183808.overview: A space invader style shooter created primarily by Neil Kendall (aka rubikWizard) and to a lesser degree Neil G. Raine when Neil was 13 or 14 years old as his first attempt at assembly coding.

183810.overview: A crosshairs shooting game simulating the shotgun trap-shooting experience.

183824.overview: A horizontally scrolling shooter also published in Videogiochi Settimanale #01. Get the hell out of there" screamed his monitor. With a blinding CRAAASH the comet had struck TRAXXION. The system had gone berserk. Glowing like a dwarf star, the space platform is breaking up. Robocars speed in panic, beyond control of the system. With the screams of a tortured beast Traxxion begins to burn like a furnace. Time, the very gold dust of your life, is running out. You tear along the track and destroy everything in your path - everything in your sight.

183845.overview:
Find treasure on a small island. X marks the spot! Become rich and famous. 

Very brief and simple game.

183846.overview: Maths educational game that was part of the "Let's Count" collection.

183938.overview: A selectable answers text adventure published as a game of "The Big 100" collection. This program is an adventure, that is, it is a game set in an imaginary world that only the computer knows and you will try to get to know too. How? Just answer the questions your Commodore 64 asks you in kind. Let's take an example: at the beginning of the game, the program tells you that you are inside a cave and briefly describes the environment that surrounds you. It then gives you some indications regarding the direction to follow to recover the fabulous treasure: if you press the N key you will go North, S towards south and so on It is up to you, and above all your memory and imagination!

183939.overview: Robotron meets Venture or something a bit like Shamus. Control Frank and help him safely through the tombs. Fire your swords at the hordes of monsters and find the treasures as you make your way through a maze-like dungeon seen from an overhead perspective.

183947.overview: Based on the original TV series. This one takes place aboard a familiar starship and is a must for Trekkies. The problem is a familiar one - the ship is in a "decaying orbit" (the Captain never could learn to park!) and the engines are out (you would think that in all those years, they would have learned to build some that didn't die once a week). Your options are to start the engine, save the ship, get off the ship, or die. Good luck.

184105.overview:
Published in Magic Disk 64 1989/08. TRIO is a game where the focus is on the fight against the round ball. The main aim of this game is to use a stick to hold a ball within a playing field until a time limit has expired. During one of a total of four levels, as many points as possible must be scored, which can be achieved as follows:

If the ball touches one of the three animated points in the middle of the playing field, you get the number of points that appears at the top of the respective display. If there are three symbols of the same type, there is a mega bonus of three times the specified number of points.
With three jokers, the player is even credited 1000 bonus points. ATTENTION! Only three clubs are available to the player for each level;
Clubs are lost if the ball disappears or if an object is touched!

184108.overview: An Italian side-scrolling shooter published in Commodore 64 Club #09. Sort of a Gyruss / Defender hybrid in which you have to shoot enough ships in order to get to the next level.

184236.overview: An exacting multi-genre test of Arcade action skills specially written for the Commodore 64. Including a shooting duel, an avoid-it action game, and a cross hairs shooter

184237.overview: Leave the pen and paper in the drawer, this Tic Tac Toe game is out of this world! Published in Game On 1992/03.

184239.overview: Triss is a platform game, where the player must stop Hephyr from taking over the world. The main task requires recovering 20 magical stones of Thefrog, scattered around Hephyr mansion. Triss will meet many unfriendly creatures and unpleasant obstacles, but he will also several useful items. Eight items can be carried simultaneously. Triss is weaponless, therefore the only way to avoid enemies is proper use of jumping skill.

184243.overview: A trivia quiz that is fun and educational.

184244.overview: A trivia quiz for fun and edification. Published as part of "Leisure Time Classics" game pack.

184246.overview: A trivia journey with many more modern (circa 1984) questions than most similar games of the time. Trivia Trek is a trivia game for one or two players. It comes with 50 trivia categories, each with 10 multiple choice questions, for a total of 500 questions (with 2000 answer choices). The software also provides the capability to create (and store) your own trivia questions which can then be used during play.

184251.overview: Trivia: Science aka CompuQuiz - Science. A trivia quiz focused on Science and nature.

184257.overview: This game was originally published on the disk with issue 10 of Compute!'s Gazette magazine. It was part of the article 'Teaching your computer English'. Gather powerful magic items and defeat the troll.

184259.overview:
Tron, a dueling worm\snake game for 1-2 simultaneous players was published in Commodore Club - software # 15 game compilation.  
 
Remember the fantastic Walt Disney movie, where the protagonist was projected into the fantastic dimension inside a computer? In this game you will be the hero of the terrible motor course that will see you engaged in exciting challenges both against the computer and against another player. There are six difficulty levels of play. Power! Take your joystick in hand and be ready to enter the Motodrome!

184261.overview: Grab a friend because this is a 2 player only Worms\Tron game.

184263.overview: A worm\tron style game by William Westerman.

184265.overview:
A puzzle game developed by Twice Effects and published in Magic Disk 64 1995/03.

Instructions for TRONIC FORCE TRONIC FORCE is a special kind of logic game. The point is to recreate a pattern displayed by the computer with the help of stones. But stones can only be moved according to a given pattern, which makes things tricky.

To move rows vertically or horizontally, the arrow is brought to the edge of the playing field at the height of the row of stones to be moved and the fire button is pressed. The row is now shifted in the corresponding direction. So that it doesn't get too difficult, the stones can change their color by clicking on the desired stone with the arrow and the fire button. A level is over as soon as the stones on the large playing area of ​​the handicap in the lower right corner of the screen correspond.

184266.overview: Avoid the slithering snakes. We are in the year 2525. As the head of the interplanetary expedition team, you have the task of recovering the ancient cultural treasures from the six temples of planet Tronix. First open the treasure hatch with the right lever and recover the treasure. Then use the left lever to activate the beamer and place the treasure in it. Never touch anything except the lever! Good luck (you will need it)...

184267.overview: You've been left in charge of Bridgeton Asylum while the manager is away and you have messed up big time. You forgot to lock the main door and all the patients have gone out into the big bright world. You need to find them and round them all up before the manager returns and you get fired. Trouble at Bridgeton is a text adventure where text describes your location and any items of interest. You type in commands to control your player with the keyboard.

184268.overview:
One or two simultaneous players can tackle this marble madness-esque platformer. In Dreams anything can happen, even colored bubbles, normally calm and harmless turning in to sticky globes that wander around swallowing poor Andrea's toys. Out of breath and sweaty, Andrea wakes up and discovers that it was just a bad dream. But this bad dream gave him an idea for the next one, which begins on his next rest! Now he is dreaming of a whole world of new toys, which he has never been able to have and it is he who guides the bubbles towards th toys to wrap them and bring them to him. But there is another bubble that appears and tries to steal the toys. This game can be especially fun if played by two friends at the same time, which whips the game to a frenzied pace. There is a small red square on the route which will randomly rearrange things to be recovered, adding to the fun. 

Published as Bollicine in Italy in Top PlayGames n.22 (giugno 1987).

184270.overview: This is Trump Tower, entry in the 2018 C64 4kb Game Coding Competition. Fun game and the Yakety Sax soundtrack is decent. Change a few sprites and you could publish this one as "Benny Hill" the video game.

184355.overview: A Pipe Mania style puzzle game developed by Digital Excess and published in both Game On 1991/07, and in Game On GE 1992/2. The aim of the game is to build a pipeline as long as possible, before liquid begins flowing from the S-marked start-field. But you only have a minute and 30 seconds to prepare. The number of pipe pieces needed to progress increases with each round.

184356.overview: An adventure game mapping trial tour de force. Break out the graph paper and the pencils, your adventurer's life may depend on it.

184357.overview: In this Shanghai variant the player has to remove the tiles with the same marks from the board until all the board is completely empty. The elimination of tiles is allowed if these tiles are projected on the same line with no other tiles in their projection path. There are a certain number of same items on each level. The player can mark the tiles, or cancel the action to change the decision. The dead-ends exist if the strategy of tiles elimination was incorrect. Games are time-limited and a certain number of 'next move' suggestions are available during gameplay.

184477.overview: An action maze game developed by Mark Tuttle & Kevin Mykytyn and published as a type-in game in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1985/10 (Issue #28).

184478.overview: A Marble Madness clone style game.

184479.overview: A Marble Madness clone and sequel to the original Turner.

184497.overview: It is more of a program than a game. When launched, a menu appears with four options. The first launches a picture story with rhyming text, the second allows you to print a card, the third gives you the option to write and print a letter to the man in the red suit, and the fourth which is a game that consists of arranging a picture from scattered pieces that can be moved with the cursor keys.

184498.overview: A puzzle game where time is the key (at least on the face of things) created by Kopido Games and published in both Game On 1992/09, and in Game On GE 1993/1.

184501.overview: Technically this is a multi-scrolling shooter, but shooting takes a big backseat to making sure you don't touch any of the walls or outcroppings or they will zap you Berzerk-style, Guiding around these obstacles is the greater part of the challenge. The game plays more like an avoid-it game than a shooter in that respect.

184504.overview: A SEUCK shooter with some Mario-esque sprites for one or 2 player simultaneous cooperative play.

184507.overview: A single screen platformer created by Jolse Maginnis and the crew at Bad Bytes and published in both Loadstar #165, and in Reset #10 Mix-i-Disk. The game is set in the far off year of 2010 where the world is in turmoil and the evil forces of darkness have taken over the world. The Evil Emperor of the underworld has put a curse on the Earth and you are the only one who can save it. You can do it by surviving 30 levels of danger and fun! The game was orginally published by CP Verlag in 1995.

184516.overview: An avoid it style game for one or two player simultaneous and cooperative play.

184518.overview: Head to head Tetris style game developed by Argus Experience Designs and published in Game On 1992/06. Try to form a row of 3 identical blocks horizontally, vertically or diagonally. When done the involved blocks will disappear. Your game is over when the blocks reach the top of the screen. In case of emergency you have 3 Jokers available. All blocks of the same kind the Joker touches first will disappear.

184580.overview:
A puzzle\brain game published in Magic Disk 64 1992/09. 

Explaining the goal of this puzzle game is perhaps even harder than explaining the strange user interface. On each level there are several stones (but that is also the only parallel to Perplex) that are scattered around in a disordered manner. It is your task now to bring discipline and order into this heap of pigs, i.e: all dark and all light blocks must be lined up. This is not done by simply moving it, but by a new kind of "twist". You can move and swap pieces in a 3 section area, but every move takes time and it is ticking by quickly!

184583.overview: A 2 player only game for simultaneous Pac-Man style play. Originally released as part of the 2009 MiniGame Compo.

184584.overview:
In Two-to-One, the player controls a magic wand which has to find its way through 20 mazes. The goal is to collect clocks, tied to a time bomb, within the time limit. However, the main challenge is avoiding to ram against obstacles. The wand can be turned in all directions and when playing in two-player-mode, each player controls one end of the wand. 
 
Published as Zip to Win in Italy in both Special Program n.71 (dicembre 1990) and in Hit Parade C64 n.53 (Febbraio 1991).

184585.overview: Published in Magic Disk 64 1990/01. "Make something new out of the old ", that's how you could describe our new motto for some oldies. This time we have a new version of the classic PHOENIX ready for you. As you know, PHOENIX is the 3-4 year old game that even the best shooting maniac had to surrender to at some point. The programmer of TX-THE GAME has reissued this goodie, provided it with flawless Digi-Music and added several background graphics. Now everyone can judge for themselves whether the old games were really as bad as some claim. At TX-THE GAME you have 7 spaceships at your disposal to destroy the evil aliens.

184586.overview: An Australian shipping management strategy simulation created by Greg Perry and published in 1986. Make the most money and rule the world! Simulates aspects of the international shipping trade.

184587.overview: A Space Invaders inspired typing game. Letters slowly descend from the sky, type them in order to destroy them. Any letter that is at the bottom of a column is a valid input; mistakenly inputting another drains energy. There are 99 speeds (Anything above 80 requires a genetic mutation), and 39 lessons. These can include upper and lower case, symbols and special keys as options. Each lesson finishes with a sequence of words using the featured letters, to be input in as little time as possible, allowing for use of the delete key. Score is based on WPM, letters destroyed, minus mistakes. There is a savable high score table plus you can save your game at any time. The package includes finger placement diagrams for all variants of the host platform.

184881.overview:
Verkeers Rally is an educational game in which the player has to look for control stations in a busy and unknown metropolis to reach the finish through the knowledge of map reading and traffic rules. But the player must locate six transmitters within one hour. However, each transmitter contains a battery that only works for ten minutes. The first transmitter works from 9:50 to 10:00. The second from 10:00 to 101.0 etc. until at 10:50 the sixth transmitter battery is exhausted and the game is over. With these means the player can find the transmitters:

Large blue signs with white letters on which "Signal" is displayed; These indicate an electronic arrow in the direction of the currently working transmitter.
District map: when the player parks there and presses the fire button, you get to see the part of the city where you are at that moment. A green rectangle represents the entire city; a small gray rectangle indicates in which part you are now. A small white dot is the first transmitter.
Sonar stations: if the player parks here, you will see the part of the town where you are at that moment and hear a whistle and see white dots on the screen. The faster they go, the closer you are to the transmitter.

The buildings with the inscription "Puzzle": if the player parks here and presses the fire button, you will see a part of the city where the transmitter is located. By means of the map that you find in the manual, you can find out which part of the city that is. From the third channel (from 10:20 onward) only pieces of the plan are shown. During the search for the transmitters, the game is interrupted regularly to ask the player about certain traffic situations, such as identifying which of the road users has priority. The player also has to refuel regularly at one of the filling stations. Because if the player is without petrol, there will be an automatic refuel and the player will pay penalty seconds. So the player must keep an eye on the fuel gauge at the bottom of the screen. If the player sees a black rectangle appear on the pavement, the player must stop and press the fire button; one of the transmitters has been found.

185678.overview: You are a member of the S.A.S. and you have been sent to an American Embassy to shoot terrorists that are holding hostages. The game is a 1st person shooter with the whole embassy building on the screen. There are a number of windows and terrorists or hostages will slide past the various windows in a different colour top. As the people appear in the windows you are told what colour the terrorists are wearing and these have to be shot by moving a cross-hair and pressing fire. You have only six shots and when these run out then you must move to a cross-hair in the bottom left and shoot it to reload your gun. For every terrorist shot you receive a merit and collect enough before the time runs out and you are promoted. Shoot a hostage though then you are demoted and if you are demoted from Private or let the time run out then it is game over. During the game the colour of the terrorists can also change to a different colour.

186942.overview: An educational typing tutor program with 8 levels of difficulty. THE MOST EFFECTIVE WAY TO LEARN TOUCH TYPING! TYPING TUTOR starts with the 'home keys' and automatically evaluates your typing performance, introducing you to new keys in many gradual steps as your skills develop.

188828.overview:
“3 Days” was originally to be the sequel to the popular “Valkyrie 17” game by George Stone and The Ramjam Corp.

The game was to be a text adventure, which was written using “The Biro”. Featuring character set screens, livened up with moving sprites (Including a dodo which fixated on you as its mother when it hatched), the game was shaping up well. All words in the adventure were in Carpathian, until you found a dictionary in the game.

Promising indeed, though it is unknown why it was never released, or even how far exactly it got. Its unlikely that it was finished, due to sources revealed below. Ram Jam were never too popular after the dire “Explorer” game they released for Electric Dreams, but with the guy mentioned next, maybe they were finally onto something…

190724.overview: Texas Town is a wild west themed shooter in which you have to kill stereotypical Native Americans and other cowboys/outlaws. This game was developed by Urmel using Chris Yates Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit. The year of release is currently unknown.

191424.overview:
Tegen Aanval is a Dutch language vertical space shooter for 1-2 players (alternating turns). It was developed by Onno Verschuuren and released into the public domain in 1985.

Tegen Aanval is Dutch for Counterattack.

192710.overview: TOP Side is a dungeon crawler style RPG developed by Dan Minut for the Commodore 64 using Garry Kitchen's GameMaker. The year of release is currently unknown

193609.overview: TEKS: The Educational Kids Series is a series of educational mini games/quizes developed by Australian based coder Barry "Cout" Hart and released to the public domain in 2004.

194106.overview: THEY is a charset style graphic text adventure developed by Eckhard Borkiet and published by Eway 10 Software in 2007. A version translated into German was also released in 2011.

194787.overview: Learn about computer languages while creating designs with Turtle Tracks, a simple programming language that uses turtle graphics. Use your imagination to decide which shape or scene you want to draw, then choose your colors and let the turtle be your paintbrush. You can even program a musical accompaniment for the turtle to draw by.

194796.overview:
Build fences around your opponent without getting hemmed in yourself n this variation of a Tron Light Cycles game for 1 or 2 players. 

Developed by John Rhees and published in the following:

COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1985/01 (Issue #19)

and in the book "COMPUTE!'s Commodore 64 & 128 Collection"

194891.overview: Touch Type Tutor is a typing tutor program for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published by Gameworx Software. The year of release is not currently known

196055.overview: Not to be confused with Indy's escapades in India, The Temple of Doom is a single-screen platformer in which you collect as many treasures as you can/want while avoiding the traps. Finally, collecting the ankh takes you to the next level.

196493.overview: Made with Shoot'Em-Up Construction Kit, or SEUCK, The Terminator could be described as a Commando clone. Set in post-apocalyptic future after Skynet took over and humans lost the war, you're part of the resistance fighting against the robot overlords.

196642.overview: Published in German C64 magazine as type-in, Think Twice is a puzzle game where your goal is to unify the rows with identical-colored pieces before your opponent.

196857.overview:
Trav 64 (also spelled Trav C64) is a Swedish language horse racing simulation for 1-10 players. It was developed by a man named Xerox and released in 1987.

Bet on the horse(s) you think will win, place, or show.

197394.overview: Traffic Jam is an "avoid-it" style game in which your goal is to cross the road from the bottom of the screen to the top in order to get to your house, while avoiding cars and other obstacles. The game was developed by Jeffrey D. Panicki and published in ReRun 1990/01-02. ITS FRIDAY. FIVE O'CLOCK. The heaviest traffic of the week, and you have to walk home, crossing seven lanes of speeding cars as you go. If that weren't enough, your dinner is cooking in the oven and you've got only 40 seconds before it burns up. Another day in the big city. Aarrgghh! That's the scenario for Traffic Jam, a fast-paced arcade-style game

197421.overview: Trajectory is a vertically scrolling shooter for one or two players (co-op)  developed by Richard Hawkins using Chris Yates' SEUCK. It was released to the public domain in 1988.

198678.overview: A keyboard only clone of one of the most cloned games ever. This was coded entirely in BASIC by marcosj and released into the public domain in 2009.

199392.overview:
Typing is a Ball, Charlie Brown is a typing game for one or two players.

Charlie Brown attempts to throw a basketball into a hoop or roll a bowling ball to knock down pins. As the ball is in motion, the player it given a short string of characters to type. If the player can type all of them before the ball reaches its target, the player scores a basket or a strike. Otherwise they fail. The game tracks how many strings the player has correctly typed in time. The player can set the speed of the ball and the type of characters.

199440.overview: In the electronic ring of a powerful computer, fight against a killer robot, a cruel game of freesbee. One of the few TRON games that isn't a lightcycle\Worm\Snake game, created by Brun Hugues and published in both Hebdogiciel Hors Serie N°2, Hebdogiciel Software N°2.

199627.overview: Playing a bit like Bubble Bobble, for me, Mad Springs is a good take on that arcade classic and recommended. Published in Germany in both Magic Disk 64 1991/03, and in Game On GE 1992/2. Published in Italy as Trainer in both Hit Parade C64 n.60 (Ottobre 1991) and New Special PlayGames n.43 (giugno 1991).

200600.overview: Two things are certain - Death and Taxes and in this game both are assured. In this single screen at a time Platform game, you guide Humfrey through the land of N.O.D., collecting tax on the hay. Destroy all Herberts to stay alive. To survive the land of Nods you must collect the Hods (coins from Nods) and if at first you don't succeed just restart. Created by Warren Mills of Ninja Warriors and Saint Dragon fame with music by Thomas Egeskov Petersen. This game would eventually inspire the 1994 release called Cashman by Russ Michaels.

200601.overview: A motorcycle racing and management game created by Eddie Thewlis and released by ET Software.

200629.overview:
Released by Funsoft as Time Runner in North America and by WizardSoft as Blade Runner in Italy, this Amidar style action game was created by Scott Maxwell & Troy Lyndon. 

Time Runner is a game in which you move your character along a pellet grid, which changes from level to level, while you collect points and avoid enemy characters. The goal is to, similar to PacMan, cover the entire board and fill-in each rectangular area, which will then become colored in. Time Runner was first developed on the Atari 800 and later converted to the Commodore-64.

200641.overview: A game by Steve Collins of Herobotix and Badlands fame. The unreleased game is based around a sideways space scroller in the mold of Defender, Uridium, Parallax and R-type, with the usual arsenal of weapon upgrades. The aim is to simply blast enemy crafts and collect orbs. When enough are collected, you are able to land and take control of the man on terrain, blasting enemies and saving hostages whom are imprisoned by blowing doors up with bombs. Once all the hostages are saved, its time to find your ship and blast off. When fully specced, you have 6 orbiting droid orbs, each with a lazer cannon. You can have forward and rear double cannons and also sid strafing bazookas.

200644.overview:
Enjoy 32 new levels, harder gameplay, less lives. Compete! Challenge your friends. 

The game takes place on an unnamed planet in a deadly nuclear reactor created by alien race known as the 'Cygma Elite'. You must guide your craft around 32 levels collecting the radioactive nuclear pods while avoiding obstacles and enemy seekers. Can you reach the end of the TRANCE SECTOR to eliminate this deadly alien threat?

200687.overview: The floor is lava, the ceiling is lava, the spaceships are deadly, the corridors are protected by destructive beams. If you don't have a really sensitive joystick just hit yourself in the head with a brick and move on to the next game and save yourself the frustration...that is, unless you are looking for a challenge run. Avoid all the instant death and make it through the pernicious path to the next level. Published in Game On 1990/10.

200701.overview: A puzzle game created for Game On 1991/06, it would later be remade and updated in an appropriately named Needle in the Haystack, which sums up this game. Find the indicated object in the top right corner in the playing field. Waldo is for chumps!

200731.overview: Tvillingar is a Swedish language math game for kids. It was developed by Ulf Tidstrand and published in 1990 by SYS Public Domain.

200835.overview:
A French language 2 player only Tron light cycles games for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Pierre Monsaut and published in 1984 by Sybex Inc in the following:

•    in the book: Jeux en BASIC sur Commodore 64

•    in the magazine: aBc Informatique #86

The game is completely keyboard controlled.

201129.overview: Think Again is a computerized version of the strategy/puzzle/board game Mastermind for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Ron Coffen and published in Loadstar #013 in 1985.

201453.overview:
Not to be confused with the official conversion from Mirrorsoft, Tetris! (with an exclamation point at the end) is a public domain home-brewed keyboard only controlled clone of the popular Russian puzzle game. 

This version was developed by Torsten Crass and released in 1990.

201455.overview: The Third Planet from Altair is a science fiction themed selectable answers text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Digital Monastery and released into the public domain in 2018.

202134.overview: Turbo Poker is a single player computerized poker game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Mark Neri and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1992/05.

202136.overview: TinyBubbles is a Puzzle Bobble clone for the C64. It was developed by Pixs and published by PhoenixWare in 2021 as part of the Cassette 50 Charity Competition.

202430.overview:
Are you like Madonna? Leafing through the biography of Madonna Luise Ciccone it is evident that she is quite eccentric. In fact, in the recounting of her past loves there are blonde and brown men, musicians like Dan Gilroy, disk-jockeys, drummers and actors like her current husband, Sean Penn. All varied from each other but united in by the fact that they are young, ambitious and full of artistic talent. If you want to know if you are similar to her you can take the quiz and see. It isn't that you won't answer correctly for yourself, you just might not be of the same type. 

Published in Italy in Edizione Logica 2000 Supplementi #04 - Speciale n.01 - Squinzie, Sfitinzie & Paninari 64.

202933.overview:
Psytronik Software presents a debut C64 release from Stephan Katteneder with music by Saul Cross.

Take control of Chris, a down-on-his-luck bartender who is trying to impress his new boss by looking after the thirsty patrons of the Knocker's bar.  It's a bit of juggling act as you refill your pitcher, keep your customers glasses topped-up and change the barrel when needed - but it's all in a day's work as you keep your customers happy when they demand a TOTAL REFILL!

** FEATURES ** 
 
· Large animated sprites
 
· Madcap glass-filling fun
 
· Scrolling bar backdrop
 
· Funky soundtracks
 
· PAL & NTSC compatible

This was released in a double pack along with The Coffee Break Shootout!

204389.overview:
Thunderground is an unofficial homebnrew conversion of the Atari 2600 game by Sega of the same name. This game was developed by Nick "Arlasoft" Sherman and published on his itch.io page on July 19, 2021.

Game description:

There are six Core nuclear bases on the planet's surface. You must burrow underground to each of these bases and destroy them. But be warned, they are guarded by patrolling Core Ranger tanks that if they get you in their line of fire, will destroy you.

There are two types of tanks. The white Sentry tanks only move through existing tunnels and will only fire on you if there is clear space between you and them. The blue Digger tanks will create their own tunnels to pursue you. There is also a Sentry tank at the bottom of the screen that slowly moves towards your reserve tanks. If this tank reaches you reserves before you destroy all six bases, you lose a life. The game is over if you lose all lives.

There are enemy supplies buried in random areas that if you get them will get you bonus points. Later levels have the bases only appear one at a time or have no dirt between you and the enemy tanks, leaving them to pursue you from the start.

205422.overview:
Try to make the ball hit the round target in the centre. Kind of like as very basic implementation of pinball in a way, only with one target for the ball to hit. Also you cannot hit the squares in the corner. Hitting the squares results in a game over.

Developed by Peter Holmes & Derek J. Bush of Honeyfold Software and published by Hayden Book Company in the book Commodore 64 BASIC Programming in 1984.

While the game was a type-in, the book was also released with a floppy disk containing all the programs in the magazine already typed-in and up and running.

205425.overview: Target-X is a Missile Command clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by John McCarthy an released into the public domain in 1987

205426.overview:
Move your target on to the moving objects. Hold fire to score points, while those enemies are moving. If enough points are scored before time runs out, then you will move on to the next level.  This was actually my first ever proper game I wrote in Assembly language. It was pretty difficult stuff to handle and I was pretty pleased with the final result.

Developed by Richard Bayliss and released by Binary Zone PD in 1999.

205427.overview:
Move your target on to the moving objects. Hold fire to score points, while those enemies are moving. If enough points are scored before time runs out, you move on to the next level.

The sequel to Richard Bayliss' 1999 game, Target-X.

205492.overview:
The Authentic Tetris is an unofficial conversion of Atari's arcade conversion of the classic puzzle game. This conversion was developed by P.A.N.O.R.A.M.A. (on coding and music) and graphics by Sez, and released into the public domain sometime in 1991.

The cracking group Army of Darkness released a trained version on September 19, 2021

205712.overview:
In TRD: Total Reality Delusion, you are a normal person, somehow transported to a most abnormal place. You seem fated to wander around this strange place, unless you can find a way back to your more sane world.

TRD: Total Reality Delusion was developed by Simon Avery and published by The Adventure Workshop in 1991.

205714.overview: Titan is a French language side scrolling shooter for one player published by Micro Application Software. The developer and date of publication are unknown as of right now.

205715.overview:
Tiradians is a 1-2 player Galaxian clone for the Commodore 64. It was coded nealry entirely in basic David Rees and published as a type-in program in Your Computer 1985/01. It was also published in cassette form in the Spanish version of Your Computer Issue #1.

The game is somewhat slower paced than most Galaxian clones, but that's primarily because of the code being nearly completely in BASIC.

206457.overview: Battle your way through space, against a myriad of alien invaders. Score extra points for each alien hit. Don't let the aliens or their bullets hit you. Otherwise, say bye, bye to one of your spaceships. Good luck and have fun!

206638.overview: Tanks vs Aliens. Defend the planet, you may be our only hope! Released as part of the Street Games "Red Pack"

207690.overview: Trap Boulder 1 is a Boulder Dash game made by Leon (aka CCF) in the Netherlands using Peter Liepa's Boulder Dash Construction Kit in 1988.

207691.overview:
The followup to Trap Boulder 1 (there was no Trap Boulder 2, unless it somehow got lost) 

Unlike the first Trap Boulder, which was developed by Leon, someone named Eric also worked on this one along with Leon. 

A Boulder Dash game developed using Peter Leipa's Boulder Dash Construction Kit. Also, just like Trap Boulder 1, Trap Boulder 3 also has an unknown release date.

207692.overview:
The final game in the Trap Boulder series. However, unlike the first two, neither Eric nor Leon are credited as the developer, instead the developer is credited as CCF.

Created using the Boulder Dash Construction Kit. Just like the first two game, this one's release date is also unknown

208600.overview:
THE STORY:

Our hero - EL GRINGO - is infamous for being the fastest and most dangerous gunslinger in the wild, wild west. But he is tired of killing, and wants to retire from his gunslinger career to settle down with his true love, MISS. JIGGLYTITS. However, having this stellar reputation tempt outlaws from the whole wide west to seek him down for duels! Will it be possible for EL GRINGO to survive his retirement day and get to his true love?

AIM OF THE GAME:

To get to his true love, EL GRINGO has to gun down 6 outlaws on 3 different stages: The Desert, The City and The Graveyard. Each outlaw is slightly quicker than the previous, so EL GRINGO has to summon all his reaction, speed, and will to survive.

HOW TO PLAY:

Press space to start the game. Place your fingers on the keyboard while you GET READY. When a random character is displayed on the screen, you have to press the same character on the keyboard to draw and shoot your gun! If you are too slow, or you press the wrong character, you will get wasted.  To quit the game and return to the intro press "RUN/STOP"

Released as part of Reset #10 Mix-i-Disk and also on Megastyle's itch.io page.

208856.overview: Blast enough aliens to complete the level and watch out for them colliding into you. Also watch out for the deadly background. Crash into this and you will become toast. A horizontally scrolling shooter for your pew pew pleasure.

208858.overview:
Thrust brings realistic physics and inertia-based movement into arcade games, directly influencing titles like Oids, as well as Exile from Audiogenic by the same author. The action is viewed from the side, with the graphics drawn in vectors, in keeping with the mathematical nature of everything that unfolds. 
 
This new gold version includes added joystick controls and increased challenges. 

As a Resistance fighter, the player must fly into enemy lines in order to steal Klystron Pods to power more advanced starships, using your tractor beam to take them. A network of mounted guns are aiming to shoot the player down – these can be disabled by shooting their power source, but eventually this will explode, forcing the player to flee. Some of the later levels feature reverse gravity, which increases the difficulty of the gameplay.

208860.overview: A breakout game created by TNT likely in 1992 or 1993 that has a very confined feel to it, and can be extremely difficult to play for long.

209060.overview:
An April Fool's Day joke of a game for the youngsters that want to try TGGS without many baddies. Spoofing popular Junior edition games for introductory level playing. It still manages to have some difficult spots and is a decent into into the game mechanics for someone who never mastered TGGS back in the day. 
 
After falling into a dark, deep sleep, little GIANA finds herslef in a mysterious dreamworld where everything is strange and ...FORGET IT! 
 
Have fun little dwarves, now play your own special Giana Sisters without any pressure, feel free to cheat if you want. High Score saver is disabled if cheatmode is ON.  
 
33 levels, just like the first one. It is getting darker and darker and every fourth level is a cave by night. Creepy isn't it?! High scores will be saved automatically. If you become a pro, teach your parents to play. Then take a break and go out and see the sun. Go Outside and play with friends, have fun in the real world. Welcome to The Great Giana Sisters Junior!

209070.overview:
Tenebra is an atmospheric puzzle game with rogue-like elements. Guide the hapless protagonist to the exit, but also keep in mind that he is afraid of darkness and refuses to walk in the dark areas.

The game contains 25 levels and works on both PAL and NTSC machines.

209071.overview:
The game involves answering questions in English on one of six subject categories to gain moves, and answering questions on special squares to gain one of the six 'Wedges' you need to gain the right to take on the final winning question. 

An update to previous releases including the new categories from the 3rd Edition board game and all new questions.  

New Catagories are Broadcasting, Publishing, News, Life and Times, Silver Screen and R.P.M.  
 
A part of 6 can all play together!

209597.overview:
This game for Commodore 64 is the port of Tutankham, an arcade game developed by Konami in 1982.

The game works perfectly on both PAL and NTSC models. However, for game speeds similar to the original arcade game, it is suggested using an NTSC model.

Overview:

In this game, the player controls an explorer who is robbing Tutankhamun's tomb. The player will search for precious treasures (maps, lamps, chests of gold & jewels, and, above all, the golden mask of King Tut) and fight off the various creatures that guard the tomb to ultimately find the way through the catacombs.

Gameplay:

The player must guide the explorer through a series of progressively more difficult mazes across different stages. The explorer may move in four directions, but can only fire in two directions, left and right, making the player helpless in vertical shafts. There are also "warp zones" located in random parts of each maze that allow the explorer to be teleported from one area of the maze to another. There are several different creatures that constantly materialize from "spawning zones" within the maze and attack, including crows, snakes, bats, dragons, and other magical beings. Those creatures can be destroyed to score between 20 and 60 points with either bullets or a "flash bomb". The explorer has a single "flash bomb" per life that destroys all enemies on the screen. On each stage, the explorer must pick up keys in order to unlock the door to the room where each of the treasures are kept, allowing the passage to the next stage. Along the way, the explorer may grab optional treasures (rings and coffers) for bonus points. If the timer reaches zero, the player's ability to fire is removed. Bonus points are awarded based on the amount of extra time left over when a stage is completed. After the player has recovered the King Tut's treasures in all the stages, the game starts over again with increased difficulty and more keys to pick up.

At 30,000 points, the player earns an extra life.

209601.overview:
Help this little green monster in reaching the end of each level. Avoid deadly obstacles such as cactuses, birds, snakes and scorpios. Don't even ask why she is constantly running.

T-Rex 64 offers 14 action packed levels in 3 distinct worlds, dedicated music, joystick and keyboard support. This single file game works well with real machines and emulators, any CBM disk drive, tape, SD2IEC and Easy Flash.

Both PAL and NTSC machines are supported, except for "the very early 64 cycles per raster" NTSC variants. If you have any problems with this particular VIC-II model, please post a comment below and I'll try to fix it.

Pro tip: if you're bored with PAL version, try NTSC - the gameplay is more "interesting" there! Released by BOBR games as part of the Double Dino compilation cartridge.

210027.overview: Nice fix-the-pipes game released by Markt & Technik in 64'er Sonderheft 49 and created by Marko Schröder.

210028.overview: A single-player arcade style game created by System-X, with great music by Richard Bayliss and released as the CSDB C64 Fun Compo 2021.

210251.overview:
You're lost and don't know how you got here or where you've been. The only item you're carrying is your trusty Nokia. Can you find your way back home?

This is a txt spk adventure for the C64 Cassette 50 Competition - all code must sit below $1000 in memory.

Apologies to anyone who has English as a second language. Or a first language...

Vocabulary:

N, S, E, W, U, D
TAKE, DROP, EXAMINE, USE, ENTER, CLIMB, GIVE

Example:

TAKE SPOGGY
EXAMINE GRAVE

210270.overview: Far, Far Away… There exists a weird and wonderful world of right-angles and crazy geometry. In this land populated by square trees, square clouds and square people, Mr Cube has fallen in love. However, our hero’s love interest is on the opposite side of the world – and between them lies a land full of hazards, obstacles and dangerous critters! Not only that, but Mr Cube is flat broke, and he needs to raise enough cash during his quest to ensure that he can pay for safe passage home for both himself and his sweetie! Oh, did I forget to mention that time is incredibly tight? Mr Cube will have to run and jump as quickly as he can if he’s to make it before his energy runs out. He’ll need all his stamina for the ceremony of geometrical pairing!

210280.overview:
A studio Ghibli inspired fan game. Help Chu-Totoro catch the acorns before the timer expires. Run left and right to catch the falling acorns. Make sure you collect the set numbers of acorns needed before the time limit expires at the top of the screen. Then you will advance to the next stage. 

This game, despite its updates is still in preview mode and will be fully released soon.

210513.overview: A nice combination between the classic tetris and games like archanoid

210514.overview: A horizontally scrolling SEUCK game created by Alf Yngve and published in Commodore Format 1992/11 (Issue #26).

210586.overview: A vertical Pong clone for 1 or 2 players developed by The Power Unit and published in 64'er 1988/09, as well as 64'er Sonderheft 42.

211383.overview: This game for Commodore 64 is a tribute to Tutankham, an arcade game developed by Konami in 1982. This version is made up of 7 completely new stages. In this game, the player controls an explorer who is robbing Tutankhamun's tomb. The player will search for precious treasures (maps, lamps, chests of gold & jewels, and, above all, the golden mask of King Tut) and fight off the various creatures that guard the tomb to ultimately find the way through the catacombs.

213288.overview: You are Chief Super Intendant Tracey Cisco, a fearless chief officer commander, who has been sent to Barkley city by his boss, the chief crime commissioner. Crime has been pretty rife recently. There have been a series of bank robberies and jewellery heists. Robbers are carrying bags filled with loot and they must be stopped immediately! Initially released on Zzap! 64 Micro Action issue 7 cover mount.

214878.overview: A golf game by Matthew Clarke aka Larcky aka Matth3w was in the Forum64 & Protovision Game Competition 2017 - Sports event. A precursor to the unfinished, upgraded Top-Hole Golf.

215544.overview: Two, to, Too is an educational quiz game for thje Commodore 64. The game quizzes the player on the proper forms of two, to, and too. Ther game was developed and published by Commodore Educational Software. The year of release is not known as of right now.

216578.overview: Torpedo is a single-player keyboard controlled nautical themed shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Larry Hatch and published in the book "25 Advanced Games for the Commodore 64" in 1984.

217189.overview: A cat themed breakout game by Till Harbaum and published in 64'er Sonderheft 30 in 1988.

217208.overview: A text adventure created by Crazy Olaf and released in 1987. In the game you must find the evil Wizard Gornatan and destroy him.

217209.overview:
Toop is a minimalistic puzzle game for Commodore 64/128, 16/Plus4 and Atari ST, inspired by a game called Qop by Quiet River.

The aim is to guide the ball (El Toop) into the portal (The Slipgate), by using the blocks and avoiding the borders and spikes.

217210.overview: An avoid-it style game from the Italian publisher, LVC. The game was released in 1986. Run across the screen, avoiding all the items (like teapots, wrenches, pots, scissors, spiders, glasses and even a thermos!) falling from the sky and pick up the bags and return them to your side of the screen to gain points. When you get enough bags across you proceed to a new country and background. Make your way across the continent on your tour de Europe.

217211.overview: Twas the night before Christmas, when all through the FREEZE64 house, not a creature was stirring, not even a mouse! Pocket LCD Style Gaming on your C64! Developed by Blue Bibly, programming & graphics by Jason Oakley. Additional programming by Old Skool Coder and music by Michael Richmond.

217212.overview: A horizontally scrolling shooter from Richard Bayliss and Jon Williams and released in 2004 and published in Commodore Free #070.

217213.overview:
An action collect-em-up game created by Tony Brantner and published in RUN 1992/05-06 magazine. This action game will drive you crazy in minutes and keep you entertained for hours. Traverse combines features of Pac-Man and Pinball, with unique twists of its own. Like Pac-Man, it's a travel-the-path-and-eat-the-dots game, each level being a maze with dots along the paths. Unlike Pac-Man, however, you don't direct the ball with traditional joystick commands. Instead, your joystick controls yellow flippers at each intersection of the maze.  Press the fire button to start, then guide the ball across all of the dots, making them disappear. Pressing your joystick in the 8 possible directions will make your ball deflect right, left continue straight or bounce back when it hits the intersection. You'll need to experiment with the controls the first game to get the hang of it.  To pause the game, press the SHIFT-LOCK key.

A game consists of three turns, and for each turn a timer counts down to zero. The timer counts down from 100 at level one, from 96 at level two and so on. At the higher levels, the ball also rolls faster. When you collect all the dots you advance to the next level. In level one, you earn one point for each dot you eat, in and end your turn. level two you earn two points, and so on. Clear a level, and you get a 1000 point bonus. Earn 10,000 points, and you win an extra turn. The turn ends when you run out of time or lose the ball.
 
OUT OF CONTROL
So far, so good. The hazards you find scattered along the paths, however, can quickly confound you! Spinners-the only permanent hazards-send the ball off in random directions. The other hazards turn off and on every few seconds. U-shaped magnets hold the ball until the hazards disappear. Round bumpers reverse the ball's direction. Diamond-shaped teleporters zap the ball to one of the spinners. Purple squares take the ball and end your turn.

217214.overview: Trigon is a 1987 Tron light cycles-type game for up to 3 players. Developed by Hansjörg Beck and published in 64'er Sonderheft 17.

217215.overview:
Triton is a 1-player vertically scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by The Power Unit and published in both 64'er Disc 1990/01 and in 64'er 1999/07. A robust "Finger of Fire" is required for this shooter.  
 
In the year 2095 hostile aliens besiege the planet Triton in the Orion star system. A few resistance fighters have gathered in a remote area to develop a weapon against the invaders: the DX-11, a gigantic spaceship with ultra-modern equipment. The day of reckoning has finally come...
This is where you come in. Although you are neither involved in the resistance movement nor in the development of the fighter, you are given the "honorable" task of getting the potatoes out of the fire for the inhabitants of this planet. Well then, cheers! The aim of your mission is to destroy 100 ground stations in each level. You will be severely hampered by a few barriers that can neither be shot down nor flown over. Whole squadrons of alien spaceships scurry around between your feet and leave small guided mines as a nice souvenir. Your DX-11's protective shield can handle a total of eight of these mines.

217216.overview: Twin Morg Valley is a role-playing game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published by Eclipse. The year of release is not currently known.

217217.overview: The Two Vikings is a two-player versus German language RPG for the Commodore 64. It was published in Magic Disk 64  1989/03

217661.overview: Tontaubenschießen is a German language skeet shooting game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Günter Lutz & Bernd Lutz and published by SVS in 1985.

217662.overview: Tonido is a public domain logic/brain game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by a coder named Murdock/Cross and released in 1992.

217938.overview:
Three Interactive Adventure Games, released independently for some systems but also in this compilation:

VENOM: You embark on a quest, travelling through the land in search of the evil plaguing the land.

KOBYASHI NARU: Three quests await you as you seek to join three items that belong to the Immortals.

SHARD OF INOVAR: As an apprentice, you must take over your master's role. But, you must first find the Shard of Inovar before the first rains hit to cast your spells....

217961.overview:
A 3D platform style game created by Eric Haines and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1988/05 (Issue #59), and also in Best of Gazette 1988 (Disk Issue). In this fast-paced action game for the 64. You enter a strange new universe where your skill and cunning are put to the test. To survive, you must trap a constantly moving sphere before your time runs out — or you trap yourself.  

"Trap" takes you to another universe, another dimension. Trap's world consists of an array of colored blocks hanging in ink-black space, set against a blanket of distant, sparkling stars. 

Two beings inhabit this strange place, each with a geometrical form; a sphere, which continuously bounces from block to block, and a flat square, which lies atop the blocks, blinking patiently. In Trap, you're the blinking square, and your objective is to trap the bouncing sphere and use its kinetic energy for your survival.

218024.overview: TRISTAM ISLAND is a text adventure made from the mold of Infocom; expect a large geography to explore, lots of prose, a rich parser, diverse puzzles, some humor and some darkness. To use Infocom's classification, I'd rate the game's difficulty as "Standard"; however, the game's design is modern and eschews all the frustrations commonly associated with 1980s text adventures. No hunger timers, no frustrating mazes, no blocking situations that force you to restart!

218164.overview:
Let me introduce you to my friend Turdle the Turtle. He's a bit of a Billy-No-Mates, but look at him. Still got a smile..... but do you know why he's smiling? Well, his favourite game is Wordle and the gang at Megastyle have decided to do their 'shit take' on Wordle and create a game just for Turdle the Turtle to cheer him up. He has one good friend, Roysterini. Nobody else can put up with Turdle cos he stinks. 
Why don't you, yes you, a trusty C64 fan, show your love for Turdle by playing the game in his name?

Just like Wordle, the game we all love and adore....the game we love to see cascading through our Twitter timelines.... Turdle is a word game where you get 6 chances to guess the random word. This is a bit different though. Is it? Yes it is.

In Turdle, all words are related to, well..... shit in one way or another, either literally or loosely. Euphemisms, slang, related words and all that malarky.
Unlike Wordle though, Turdle is a highscore chaser. You don't just get one shit shot a day, you can keep going and try to beat your best score. Turdle initially started as a silly idea for the RESET 4Kb Craptastic Compo for C64, but I decided to embellish on it a little and release it now, while there's still steam rising off it.

218242.overview:
Ten Great Games is a compilation from Gremlin Graphics. It includes the following 10 games:

Avenger
Bounder
Footballer of the Year
Future Knight
Highway Encounter
Jack the Nipper
Krakout
Monty on the Run
Trailblazer
West Bank

218335.overview: Tanc is a two-player only tank vs tank shooter for the Commodore 64, similar to games like Combat on the Atari 2600. It was developed by Gregg Barnett and published as a type-in game in the book "Commodore 64 Games Book 2" in 1984.

218445.overview: A shoot'em up created by Darryl Bartlett with the help of the SEUCK in 1989. In it, one to two players take on a futuristic city battle, avoiding turrets and blowing up the multitude of other tanks that will try to take you out. Get a friend, you're going to need all the help you can get to avoid being blasted to smithereens.

218579.overview:
Tree Tutor for Tots is an educational math game for the Commodore 64.

You have the option to see the apples in the trees the whole time, or to only see the apples if you guess wrong.

Every time you answer correctly, a bird takes an apple from the tree and put it in a basket.

The game was developed as a type-in game by Janet Arnold and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1984/03 (Issue #09).

A version of the game was also released for the VIC-20 in the same magazine.

218584.overview:
The Tenement is a single-screen platformer for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Gus Vakalis and published in the following.

-   Loadstar #090
-   Game Star #1

An official sequel, "Beneath the Tenement" was released in 1993.

219120.overview:
You and your friends are about to go on a trip, but suddenly you find yourself somewhere else. The place you find yourself in is similar to your hometown and yet different. Why are you here? Where are your friends? One thing is clear: You'll get home... but at what cost?

This game was made during the Klagenfurt Winter Game Jam 2022.

219154.overview: A very basic, but strange one-player game released in 75 Spill Datatronic and as part of The Big One game compilation from Alpha Software

219214.overview: While we are going through pretty tough times in lock down at the moment. I wanted to make use of some of my time with boredom. So while there was nothing else to do, I worked on a fun little game, which I designed and programmed in Arthur Jordison's CBM PRG STUDIO (Which I recommend you check out, it's a fun cross-platform CBM development suite) . The game is called "Toilet Paper Stacker". The Commodore 64 has contracted a deadly virus, which has now been concealed inside a glass cabinet. Your job is to try and break the glass by stacking over sized toilet paper on to the glass cabinet. After a 7th successful stack, the glass will break and the virus gets wiped out. You will have five minutes to score as many points as you possibly can. There's a slight catch though. You have 3 chances. If you drop a toilet roll and it doesn't successfully stack, a chance is lost. The game ends after all chances are lost, or the time runs out. Try to score as many points as you possibly can. I know this game is unrealistic, but it should be fun. Released as part of the CSDb C64 Lockdown 2020 Fun Compo.

219668.overview:
Psytronik Software in association with ICON64 present TERRESTRIAL! A multi-part C64 sci-fi action adventure featuring 9 different mini-games combined into one epic arcade adventure! Take on the role of CAPTAIN HAVOC as he battles against the invading alien hordes!

Returning from a routine patrol on the outer edge of the solar system Captain Havoc receives an urgent communication from Moon Base Ceti. Homeworld is under attack from an unknown alien force! As the only ship in range it's up to Captain Havoc to investigate.


** STAGES ** 

STAGE 1: Board and launch your attack craft.

STAGE 2: Man the assault cannons and take out the approaching enemy fleet.

STAGE 3: Travel to an occupied city via the canyon. Take out protector ships.

STAGE 4: City battle - engage enemy units. Clear all structures to secure landing zone.

STAGE 5: Tank battle. Traverse landscapes & destroy enemy shield generators.

STAGE 6: Battle the enemy guardians in a thrilling laser-disc battle!

STAGE 7: Defeat the alien brain!


** FEATURES **

· Several different gameplay styles

· Detailed graphics & animation

· 3D canyon battle!

· Parallaxed scrolling tank levels

· PAL and NTSC compatible

· TheC64 Mini + Maxi compatible

219993.overview:
This is a direct sequel to my popular game Tenebra, with many exciting new game play elements, including a portal gun!

Similar to its prequel, Tenebra 2 is an atmospheric puzzle game with rogue-like aesthetics. . Guide the hapless protagonist to the exit. Poor guy is afraid of darkness and refuses to walk in the dark areas.

220134.overview: The T.R.S.I. The Red Serpent Invasion entry is a pretty incredible feat for the C64. An Interactive Competition entry for the Evoke demoscene party that doesn't just run smoothly ( It's really impressive ), but it also features texture walls, scalable sprites, and some would say is a very fine Wolfenstein 3D clone, albeit still in demo form.

273855.overview: Alf Yngve's classic Public Domain SEUCK game gets the SEUCK Redux treatment. This is a neat classic game from 1992, and features extra enhancements. Such as the enemy aiming for the player when shooting. Also the removal of the SEUCK slowdown syndrome (Since a lean and mean sprite multiplexor has been implemented in the source). I also added a little routine which will make the water background flow, by a simple delayed scrolling char routine. The game doesn't consist of power ups, but there's some good gameplay elements added to it. Hope you enjoy this classic futuristic blaster.

294881.overview:
Second place winner in the Forum64 Adventure Competition 2015, written by Claus. The game is an Adventure RPG with high grade music and smooth scrolling as you try to survive using unique abilities in a world overcome by disease and decay. The game is superb, with a refreshing top view perspective. You walk the hero around, and you can interact with people and objects using the menu that shows up when you hit the joystick fire button close to the person or object. The background music also helps to give the tone to the game. What is most amazing is that Claus is responsible for all components of the game: coding, graphics and music. Also the game is available in German and English, NTSC and PAL.

The game also allows you to save and restore at any time, a nice and important addition to this type of game.

294882.overview: Top-Hole Golf produced by Matthew Clarke, and is a really nice Leaderboard style game.  It has lovely graphics, courses to play Golf on, and being able to control your swing does the give the game its own charm.

417517.overview:
A SEUCK based shooter created by Henk Nieborg and published in 1991. It has the feel of Commando about it. You must break through the hostile landscape and rescue your mates. Two players may play cooperatively.  
 
This game, despite what some incorrect spelling on some media might lead you to believe was never released by CP Verlag. That was a version of the Tough Guys fighting game, not a this shooter.

417524.overview: Not to be confused with the commercially released German text adventure of the same name, Frank Kristen's Top Secret, is also a German text adventure. The game was released into the public domain in 1987.

418300.overview:
Time Race is a miscellaneous action game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Karin Liebig and published in Input 64  1987/11. The aim of the game is to bring a small ball over a race track to the finish line as quickly as possible. The ball must not touch the course boundary or any of the moving or unmoving obstacles. If he does, you lose the ball and start again from where you started; A total of six balls are available for all five levels. If the ball, coming from below, has rolled into the hole marked "Goal", you can continue with the next level.

If you have completed all five levels, you can repeat the whole game with an increased level of difficulty. People who are more curious than sure-footed can look at the different levels of the game by pressing the left arrow key; and if things get too hectic for you, the F1 key will keep you quiet until you press the keyboard again. You can play either with a joystick in port 2 or with the AZ and / keys, which (in this order) correspond to the directions up, down, left and right.

418304.overview: Timekiller is a puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Fender Tucker and published in Loadstar #104 in 1993.

418306.overview: Time Struggle was an attempt to make a Uridium clone for the Commodore 64 that had two-player co-op. The game is two-player only. It was developed by Daniel Millard and published in 64'er Sonderheft 42 in 1989.

418522.overview:
The old oracle said you are, *The Chosen One." Your job is to free the village from the Euil dragon and other monsters, that oppress anyone for very long time. Will you be able to complete this extremely difficult task? Armed only with your sword and your courage you are getting ready to enter the ancient prison. You see immediately that all cells are numbered. Good luck! You will need it... 
Game released in both English and Italian.

421819.overview:
TamaDogi is an attempt at creating a virtual pet/tamagotchi (a dog in this instance) for the Commodore 64. It uses PETSCII graphics for the dog. It was developed by Vintage Computing Carinthia and released at Commodore-Treffen Graz $3D on Jun2 24, 2023.

It was also released as part of One Hour Game Jam #425.

421857.overview: A game by Toby Hughes (written when he was 13) and with music by Andrew Colin, published in Commodore Computing International v02-12 (May 1984). It is an adventure game which involves the Transmat - a machine similar to the one used by Captain Kirk and his crew to beam up and down, photon lasers, explosives, a long scarf and a sonic screwdriver because why not?

424189.overview:
As a tyrant in control of a poor country, you will eventually lose this game unless you change to a democracy, destroy the other countries, put hundreds into the secret police, and spend lots of money brainwashing people before elections. Just like real life!.

This game was developed by Toby Matthews and published in the book ""Winning Strategy Games on the Commodore 64" in 1984.

424216.overview:
Timeslip for the Commodore 64 is a public domain conversion of a C16/Plus 4 game of the same name. It was developed by the coder of the original version.

Game Description:

On a distant planet, 36 Time Orbs have been placed in three zones and in 24 hours time the planet will be destroyed unless all the Orbs are destroyed. You have been sent to the planet to save it by controlling three different vehicles and crafts in the three zones, and they are the planet's surface, underground caverns and underwater. The game is a side view horizontal scrolling shooter where the screen is split into three parts showing all three vehicles and crafts, and they are a space fighter for the surface, jetpack for the underground caverns and a mini-sub for underwater. As the game starts you select which one to control, and you move from right to left destroying all aliens, vehicles, weapons and the orbs as the main clock counts to zero.

424437.overview:
Unofficial conversion of the 1984/'85 game for VIC-20, Spectrum and Plus/4 by Artúr Bujdosó in 2023. You play the role of Andros who was banished years ago by King Salimos and can only return when he returns kidnapped Princess Diana and the King's lost treasure taken by an evil Necromancer. You have journeyed to the Necromancer's home, The Tower of Evil to retrieve the stolen treasure and Princess Diana in this top view flick-screen game. Starting on the ground floor, you must search the rooms looking for treasure and a key to use a magic stairway to move up a floor to finally reach the seventh floor where the Princess is. 
 
Occupying each floor are various creatures that need to be avoided or shot with fireballs from your fingertips and if you touch a creature then you lose one of five lives but a goblet will give you invincibility for a limited time. Once you reach the seventh floor you must find a chest to place the treasure in before finding and rescuing the Princess who will disappear and you have to start the whole quest again. Two players can play and each player takes it in turns to play when the other player is killed.

425207.overview: A hacked version of the official C64 port of Tetris that removes the sudden drops that made the C64 port somewhat annoying to play.

425260.overview:
With this program you can use your Commodore 64 to generate PETSCII tarot card insights - for the past, the present and the future.
