Think of an open-ended question you would like an answer to and deal the cards. The leftmost card you get shows insights for the past, the middle one for the present and the rightmost one for the future. The interpretation depends on whether the card gets placed on the table upright or reversed.

Is it a game? Not sure.
During halloween 2022 it was submitted to game making compo at ZOO '22 where it reached 2nd place.

425426.overview:
Trio Word Game is a derivative of Wordz and Binal Wordz, only that you find three words consisting of 4 letters.  This version is more challenging as there are more words to solve with the same number of guesses applying to the game. 

Today is also the 03/03/2023, so it the perfect day to release the game!

Each word has a different background tile to distinguish each word that is being played.     

To assist you with solving the words, a random letter in each word is provided for you for free.   Tip:  Use this letter to your advantage to eliminate certain words/letters and to help you find the words faster!  

Guess a four letter word and then press [Return].  If you want to make a change to your guess before submitting your word, you can press backspace to fix any letters.

After each guess, the colour of letters will give you clues to solve each word   

    Green - right letter, right position 
    Yellow - right letter, different position 
    Gray - letter not in the word. 

At the end of 7 attempts and you have not guessed all three secret words, they will be revealed to you.

425459.overview: Race against the clock to create a 20 tile before the grid fills to the top. Combine tiles of the same value by smashing them into each other. Break linked tiles by combining one. A fast-paced puzzle game written for the 2022 Reset Magazine Craptastic Compo.

425473.overview: Released in the 2020 C64 4kb Game Coding Competition (27th place), by Romwer. In the game you are the teleporter device. When a guy enters the teleporter, your job is to quickly guide him through the teleportation vortex, which humans can't see, of course. Wiggle your joystick to trace the path as fast as you can right after the teleportation process has started. You will see the vortex path briefly while the guy is walking towards the teleporter. It is your responsibility to memorize it thoroughly enough to not kill the person on his teleportation journey. Good luck!

425490.overview: Treasure Island is a single player strategy game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Bob Mockford and released into the public domain in 1991.

425546.overview:
All the Turrican you can handle!
A compilation of both Manfred Trenz Turrican games in one easy to use release. 
Turrican
Turrican II: The Final Fight

425623.overview: Tiny Invaders is a simple clone of Space Invaders that primarily uses PETSCII/character graphics for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Back to the 8 bit and released into the public domain in 2021.

425837.overview: Trainyard. Control the switches to get your trains to the right stations

438328.overview: Toad Away (a play on the phrase towed away) is a 1-player, graphically simple, but still playable clone of Frogger for the C64. It was developed by Cameron Kaiser and published in Loadstar #164 in 1998.

438467.overview:
Triads is a 2 player only board/strategy game for the C64 it was developed by Mike Singleton (of Midwinter I and II fame) and released in Commodore User 1985/06 (Games Extra Book), as well Stonysoft #0040,and  Stonysoft #0519.

The board kind of resembles a Chinese Checkers board, however the game is not even close to that game...

MOVING AROUND
-------------
A triode can move to any position on the board not already occupied. Movement must be along the Alpha, Sigma and Zeta axes and you cannot jump over triodes of either colour blocking your path. Only switched on triodes can move.

FIRING
------
A switched-on triode can fire in any of the directions Alpha, Sigma or Zeta. It must fire at an enemy triode that is also switched on and there must be notriodes between the attacking triode and it's target.

THE PLAY
--------
Both players start with all their triodes switched on. The green player starts, then each player takes it in turn to either move one
of their triodes or fire at an enemy triode. The object is to force your opponent into a position where they cannot take their turn, i.e. move or fire at one of your triodes. This usally happens when all of their surviving triodes are switched off; in rare cases, their switched on triodes maybe completley boxed in by your switched off ones.

KEYBOARD CONTROLS
-----------------
A - Direction Alpha
S - Direction Sigma
Z -  Direction Zeta
M -  Move a triode
F - Fire with a triode
RETURN - Confirm movement or firing
DELETE - Cancel movement or firing

To start a new game, press the COMMODORE key and N. The coloured stripe in the cursor indicates who's turn it is.

Place the cursor over one of your switched on triodes and press M or F. Next using the movement keys A, S and Z, position the cursor on the node you wish to move to, or over the enemy triode you wish to fire at. Finally, press RETURN to execute the move or DELETE to cancel.

439152.overview: Titus is a German language turn-based political strategy game for the Commodore 64. The game supports 1-9 players. It was developed by Arnd Schröder and published in Magic Disk 64 1990/07

439153.overview: Table Tennis Manager, is a sports management sim that focuses on table tennis (or ping pong, if you prefer). The game was developed by Shwimaik-Software and published in Magic Disk 64 1992/10.

439768.overview: Tric Trac is a dice based gambling game for 1-5 players. It was developed by Image Design and published by J & F Publishing in 1997.

444308.overview: Try Out a Farmer's Life, plant the seed and keep the birds away, you don't need a scarecrow you are ugly enough to get the job done. If you can keep the birds at bay and the crop comes in then you make it to harvest time and can make it for another planting season. A game created for the OneHourGameJam in 2024.

446679.overview: Timo's Castle is a single screen platformer with 8 lovingly designed spaces

446890.overview:
Venture-esque game created by Scott Elder in 1989, that features the usual horror archetypes, and a title-screen that echoes The Monster Squad film and/or the C64 game Scary Monsters. 

What you must do first in the main playing screen is guide your man around the evil balloon things that look inspired by TV series The Prisoner into the nine chambers that each contain a gold bar to collect. 

The first level has the first two chambers, then at level two repeats these including the third chamber. This pattern continues until you reach the end-screen... the uneven collision adds to the silliness of it all but it's cheesy fun!

447939.overview: Embark on a pixelated journey inspired by Tony Halik, the real-life Polish explorer and filmmaker whose adventures spanned continents and decades. He was exploring ancient civilisations for NBC, Tony's love of discovery knew no bounds. Now it's your turn to step into Tony's digital shoes and unravel the mysteries of Montezuma's Castle in this nostalgic 8-bit homage.

448726.overview:
The game is a “remake” of the Flappy Bird game, whose modern gameplay is also accessible online.

The object of the game is to win all 99 levels by passing the bird through the openings in the pipes. The reward is viewing one of the four final screens.

Each level has a certain number of pipes: every two levels, the number of pipes increases by one unit. The maximum number of pipes is 20 (per level). When the bird passes a pipe through the opening, its score increases by 1.

Every ten levels also increases the speed of the bird, and this makes the game more and more difficult, because there is less room to maneuver, in order to cross the gaps. Infact, the gaps must be crossed with the maximum possible distance, under penalty of a “game over”.

The player controls the bird using any key on the keyboard. When the button is pressed, the bird accelerates upwards. When the player released it, the bird will gradually decrease its vertical speed, until it begins a slow but steady descent. To maintain the altitude it is therefore necessary to give regular “strokes” to the keyboard. To increase it, you need to hold down the key. To decrease it, simply wait, without pressing any key.

450086.overview:
At its heart, Taxi is a cave flyer. The objective is to pick up the passengers and take them to their destination without hitting the walls. 
 
Published in Happy Computer 1986/01.

451620.overview: Torreoscura is an original conversational adventure by Bieno Marti. We are situated today, where our protagonist, a middle-aged and overworked person, urgently needs a break. Impulsive and without thinking too much about things, he receives a plane ticket by chance of fate along with a letter from an old friend of his and childhood classmate and where he invites him to spend a few days in a distant and distant town. all unknown. Without thinking about it, he starts off wanting to get out of the routine and do something different. The story begins at the moment in which, after traveling to the destination and being picked up in a taxi, he arrives at Torreoscura at the hostel, without being received by anyone and where he must discover what is happening and find out what happened with his friend.

452218.overview:
The Penultimate Ninja in "Tsunami Tōsō" a 4K craptastic C64 game by Stein Pedersen (design, code, music), Joachim Barrum (graphics) and Steven Dalton (ideas, R&D). A 2024 Reset64 4KB Craptastic Game Competition entry.

You are the penultimate ninja. As a terrible tsunami wreaks havoc on your village, it is up to you to escape the raging wave. Push the stroller holding your only son up the hill to ensure the survival of your line.

Left : Move down the hill.
Right: Move up the hill and grab hold of the stroller.
Fire (when holding stroller): Let go of stroller.
Fire (when NOT holding the stroller): A quick tap will make you jump. You must jump to get past the stroller.
Hold Fire : punch, hold for longer: power punch
Pro Tip: When holding the stroller, do a quick double-tap on the button to be able to smoothly jump over!

452293.overview:
There was an earthquake in the Kilimanjaro Mountains in Africa. As a result, a huge cave was exposed. Researchers were sent there to check what was inside. Only one man returned, who told terrible things about huge dungeons full of dangerous robots. Some of the researchers could still be there. It was decided to send a tank there to explore the dungeons and destroy the aliens. You will command this tank - good luck!

Info:

There are 15 levels ahead of you. Every second one is randomly generated. Save your ammo. You can replenish it by collecting ammo in dungeons. You can also collect additional armor that will protect your tank from one hit. Watch out for the bombs lying around. You will get bonus points for collecting the missing researchers.

452366.overview:
Tiburoncy must rescue his friends who were trapped by the fishing boats.

You must touch the enemies from above to eliminate them and get extra points. The eagle is touched from below.

Touch the key to open the cage to free the dolphin.

The lever to open the gates and rescue your friends.

At the end of the game, Daddy Shark will be waiting for you to free him.

453856.overview: This project is a clone of the classic Tetris game, developed for the Commodore 64 (C64) using Kick Assembler. The aim was to recreate the core mechanics of Tetris, including piece movement, rotation, line clearing, and scoring, while working within the constraints of the C64's hardware.

455049.overview: Transformation is a 1988 logical brain puzzle game for the Commodore 64. The game was developed by Joel Epstein and published in Loadstar #052.

456140.overview:
This is a homage to a friend turning fifty and is part a celebration of him (a demo) and part a game.

On the demo screen, press T to get some extra trippin' effects (varies over time)

Press A or B to start the game in easy or hard mode.

Move Woogie, the camel, and bounce the Lavender Sheeps into the tea cup. After some time notes start falling - catch three of them in a row to get into one of two Trippy Modes for a short time

1. Woogie gets wide and the sheeps go fast
2. Woogie turns into a tea cup and can catch the falling sheeps straight away.

Further into the game, anvils start to fall and should be avoided.

456142.overview: The goal of the game is to fill the whole game area with tiles collect and collect all numbers in ascending order. There is only one rule: Moving in the same direction cancels the previous tile, which disappears. If you hit more than 3 times into the wall or already taken location, game ends. Once the whole game area is filled with tiles, move more than 3 times in any direction and game will end with a "Victory" message :)

456487.overview:
A magical amulet, and the four runestones of Air, Earth, Fire and Water, were the basis for the power of the evil Kartos empire. With time, the empire crumbled. The last survivor, named Drewan, lived for many years after and started to repent for the evils committed by the empire. He knew that eventually, he too would die, and so he prepared. A 400 room tomb was built, and populated with a variety of guardians to protect the amulet and stones. He also provided some spells as a way to defeat the guardians, just in case some future hero needed the power of the artifacts to be used for good...

The Tomb of Drewan is basically a treasure hunt in a maze. In addition to movement around the maze, the character can perform actions (labeled on-screen from A to W) by pressing the associated keys on the keyboard. Some of these actions are always available to the player, such as Taking an item, or attacking with your Sword. These actions have a yellow star next to them. Other actions such as Arrow or Removing a section of wall require the player to have a particular object or spell, and have a red star next to them when available.

The ultimate goal is to find the artifacts, and then return to the top left corner of the tomb. Each room contains 5 treasures and one guardian. The treasures can be taken by standing to the immediate left or right, and then facing in the direction of the treasure. Inspecting the object identifies it before being Taken, which is important, because only one of each type of spell can be carried at a time. Runestones provide special useful powers. For instance, the Earth stone allows Remove earth to be cast at any time. Gold may also be found, which adds to your encumbrance (reducing strength and speed) but may also be used to pay off the tomb lord.

The guardians that patrol each room may be of two types: warrior or magic users. Warriors will wound you only when standing next to you, while magic users fire spells once they are within five squares. Each type of guardian has three different colours, denoting how difficult they are to kill. Combat occurs by facing the opponent, and using the Sword, an Arrow, or one of the various combat spells (e.g. Chaos, Water, Fire or Petrify). Once your wounds exceed 100, you receive a visit from the tomb lord, who can be paid to resurrect you. If you have not amassed enough gold to make the payment, then your life is forfeit and you lose the game.

456665.overview:
Twister is a pinball game for the C64.

It was developed by Charles M. Duncan using Olaf Lubeck's Pinball Construction Set.

It was released in 1990 as part of PCS Club Disk #13.

456697.overview: As the name suggests, Toki C64 Remastered is a radical enhancement—with all-new graphics and sound—of the Commodore 64 game Toki, originally developed by Ocean in 1991. Ocean's Toki was the licensed conversion of the eponymous arcade game, also known as JuJu Densetsu in Japan.

456701.overview:
Twister is a freeware Tetris clone/variant for the C64.

It was developed by Shane Broadberry and published in SYS PD Diskett#10 (1991).

However, the game was originally released in 1988 on BBS systems.

456710.overview:
An Italian language clone of the original Mario Bros. arcade game.

It was developed by Maurizio di Vizio and Giuseppe Demichelis, and published in Next Game #09 (06/1986) / a.k.a. "The Tourtle" in tape menu

456912.overview: Tic-Tac-Math is a mathematical take on Tic-Tac-Toe for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Robert Markland and published in Loadstar #132.

456945.overview:
You are Zintkala of the Lokota. She has lived as an outlaw since the massacre of her tribe by gold miners, ten years ago. Now she must return to defeat an evil Demon Serpent  Unk Cekula, reawakened by the reckless miners, whom her ancestors first slew in ages past.

Proceed left to right. Jump over obstacles. Avoid or shoot hazards and enemies. Try not to die. Are there any subtleties to this? Why, yes… Look out for the small flashing brown barrels, which contain valuable power ups. If your main weapon power level is at zero, the next barrel you collect will always raise that level to 1, unlocking your second pistol. Otherwise, it will grant one of three random bonuses: 1 – raise your main weapon power as far as level 3 (both pistols unlocked, rapid fire). 2 – an extra stick of dynamite, up to 4. 3 – an extra reserve life, up to 6. If the selected bonus is already maxed out, you will instead receive a protective shield that will last a little over ten seconds (effective against enemies and their shots but will not protect you if you fall into deep rapids). Along with the enemies you encounter, there are also animals that can be dangerous, but are not evil. Killing them, whether with pistols or dynamite, will displease the holy forces that have blessed your endeavour, and cause you to lose a level in weapon power. There are three stages to traverse before your fateful encounter with Unk Cekula, an evil Serpent Demon, each with its guardian:

1 – The Mining Town.
2 – The Badlands Express.
3 – The Black Hills.

457373.overview: Tusari 2 The river level packaged into a small self contained game

457487.overview: Tronix the Wombat is a Commando-inspired shmup made with Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit (a.k.a. SEUCK).

457901.overview:
Help Tyrian recover Queen Mumph's lost eggs in this fantastic game featuring 50 amazing isometric screens.

STORY:

Queen Mumph's Eggs have gone missing from the royal bedrooms. 

Tyrian, as high guard and keeper off all things err egg shaped (yes, he knows its a very stupid job!) must head out on a perilous quest and find as many eggs as possible.

Use your wham hammer to fend off the nasties that roam the royal towers, collect the precious royal eggs and use the 

portable shield generators to help you in you mission.

Be brave and be victorious, or be dead.

458002.overview:
Take a ride with little man called TANTOOMAN. 

Before he can go on his well-deserved vacation, he'll need to paint the entire maze. Our little man, while he painting the mazes, will fight against enemies and the time which counting down. Game is inspired by android game "Tomb of Mask Color" and it is well deserved port on Commodore 64.  Huge number of levels are in front of you. On start, it is easy to paint mazes, but you'll figure out that later is sometimes harder to achive that.

459052.overview:
Tropical Snake is a snake game for the c64 Developed and released by Marco Cerutti on July 8, 2025.

Eat the apples, avoid the dogs!roule simple and fun guaranteed!

459055.overview: In the wild West, the tin star is the symbol of law and order. The men who wear the tin star are respected by the community, as they face violent and cunning criminals nearly every day.

460158.overview: The game features three likeable film characters, and the player's task is to raise funds to buy back a confiscated house. To do this, you have to take part in various strange competitions consisting of elements of dexterity, decision-making and quizzes. In some locations, you can obtain ammunition, which is necessary to fight the tank on the hill. Any failures result in the loss of one of five lives, while successes can add to them. Some decisions can permanently end the game.

460783.overview: Tic Tac Too Much is a two player versus only tic tac toe game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Bill Shockley and published in Loadstar #079 in 1990.

461246.overview: Gialli Commodore #2 episode: Il Cuscino Rosa, Rapina in Famiglia

461247.overview: Gialli Commodore #3 episode: I Due Cugini, Un Furto d'Arte e Il Testimone

461249.overview: Gialli Commodore #4 episode: Una Cena al Veleno, Fine di un Attore, Club Filatelico

461348.overview:
Tiger Mission II: The Confrontation is an UNOFFICIAL sequel to Kele Line's Tiger Mission. 

It was developed by The Severals 4001 using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and released in 1988.

The game uses a stolen player sprite from the original game.

461613.overview: In this game you are leading a prehistoric tribe of hunters and gatherers. Your journey leads through a hostile landscape and you have to make difficult decisions, that will have an impact on life and death. Make sure, that as many of your tribe as possible survive the journey.

462899.overview: A simple collect 'em up for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Doug Smoak and published in RUN 1984/11 (Issue #11),  as well as RUN Gamepack Disk.

464214.overview:
The year is 2029. 

AI has developed the perfect video game slob that works as a drug and forces humanity into eternal slavery.  Only a rare breed of retro game freaks is immune to the thread.  So you decide to stop the AI by pulling the plug.  But unfortunately it has its own nuclear reactor embedded into its datacenter.   Further analysis shows, it has killed off all human employees and scientists and now acts completely independent with its converted maintenance robots.  Desperate to save humanity, you have to enter the underground lair and blow up the reactor.

The underground datacenter is comprised of 16 levels with increased difficulty, connected by various elevators.  The defending robots are repurposed maintenance and cleaning units, resulting in slow speed, limited sensor abilities and limited “weapons” range, giving you a good chance for evasion and stalking.  Weapons and armor upgrades are left in the tunnels by the original crew and can be used to improve your stats.  Your equipment will be less than adequate at the beginning, so sneaking is your best option in the early levels.

To blow up the reactor, four preliminary controls have to be disabled to allow overheating the reactor in the lowest level.  You will then have a limited time period to exit the lair.

Every elevator is a save point, so you will never lose a lot of progress when killed.  All robots will respawn when using an elevator.

The game is designed for PAL and NTSC.  The disk version requires a real 1541 or true drive emulation for the fast loader.  The single load prg will work on any system, but lacks the intro screen.

464761.overview: This was made for the 2025 Game Jam for a memory game on 8 bit computers.

469327.overview:
Tashi Delek (=Tibetan Greeting) tells the story of a Tibetan monk in search of enlightenment and inspired by my journeys and expeditions to Tibet.

Bit by bit and Level by level the lama unlocks the secrets of the ancient lamas (monks) and learns new skills such as using prayer wheels to replenish karma or uses karma to leap longer distances.

469379.overview: Tiny Harvest, bundled with the Commodore 64 Ultimate in collaboration with the new Commodore company, is a cozy farming game that you can only play if you own a C-64.

469462.overview: Tetraider is a single-player vertically scrolling shmup for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Gaetano Chiummo and published VP by Sea Software in 1992.

470341.overview: The pyramid is alive with danger. Snakes, bats, mummies, and shifting traps guard its secrets, while locked doors, pressure plates, and clever puzzles stand between you and the relics you seek. Collect keys to open new paths, crack vases with your whip to reveal golden coins, and search every corner for gems, artifacts, and sacred birds waiting to be rescued.

470526.overview: TED and LOLA is a spin-off from my "GNOM" game series

470561.overview: Tony Do It is a small yet highly enjoyable puzzle game inspired by the classic Sokoban.

471246.overview: Guide Tiny Tim through a world of obstacles and text

471259.overview: A 2 player SEUCK game developed by Mazzarella Vincenzo and released as public domain on March 31, 2026.

472145.overview: on these platforms before the flames from below rise and burn the screen. Use the keyboard for movements and complete all 50 levels!

475998.overview: You are a lumberjack racing against the clock. Chop the trr from the safe side. A branch on your side flattens you!

476096.overview: Trigger Happy is an early sideways scrolling shooter that was recovered many years ago and was being developed in the early 1990s

476245.overview: TULT 64 is a free puzzle game for the Commodore 64 that involves sliding blocks together so that all their colored sides match and their movement tallies are set to zero.

476653.overview: Let me introduce my latest creation, which is guaranteed to liven up your boring moments. This game will include everything that makes a game fast-paced, clever, and fun. It’s still in development, but you can download the demo version for free and give it a try.

477375.overview:
THE HIVE HAS AWOKEN
You are the Garden Guardian, a fiercely territorial mole digging deep beneath the soil. An infestation of ravenous Borer Beetles and acid-spitting Bombardiers has invaded your underground home. Grab your trusty pneumatic dart-pump, carve out your tunnels, and defend your territory!

477512.overview: Thin Ice is deliciously simple: the aim of each level is wipe out the nasties and head for the EXIT portal before the timer reaches zero. Binky can move freely around each level while dispatching the nasties, either by squashing them with ice cubes, or freezing them with his icy breath and smashing them to smithereens.

478702.overview: A remake of a game I originally wrote for the PET in the 1970's.

479810.overview: Welcome to TetrISO, a fast-paced puzzle game for the Commodore 64 where classic falling-block gameplay takes a whole new dimension.

479811.overview: TFREAX is a fast paced shoot-em up, adding new twists to a familiar theme.

480362.overview: Trapped in the ancient tomb, you'll have to avoid traps and huge rolling boulders. Your goal is to escape before everything collapses, but to do that, you'll need to search through the treasures for the keys that will let you pass through the rooms of this cursed old place.. Will you survive to see the daylight again?

480491.overview: Treasure Cove is an action game that takes place off a small island in the Caribbean where the player has to dive into the ocean and search for the treasure of a lost Spanish galleon. The action takes place on a single screen and the player starts out in a small boat at the top of the screen. At the bottom there are several pieces of treasure that has to be retrieved (one at a time) but the ocean is also full of fishes and other sea creatures that have to be avoided. Any contact with these (including the smallest of fishes) will lead to an immediate loss of life. A life is also lost if the player runs out of oxygen which means it's necessary to plan ahead since it's not possible to go back to the boat (and recharge the oxygen) empty handed. With the press of a button the player can move quicker but at a higher cost of oxygen. After clearing all treasure from the cove the game will move on to a new location with more valuable treasure but also with more fishes.

480878.overview:
Tricky Tetris is a complete Tetris game for the Commodore 64 and Ultimate 64, created by Zsolt Tarczali in 2026.
It has everything you would expect from Tetris: falling pieces, levels, hold, line clearing, high scores and increasingly fast gameplay. But there is one important difference: the game occasionally plays tricks on you.
Your controls may suddenly change, the entire playfield can flip upside down, rotate sideways or even appear as a diamond. Sometimes gravity simply becomes much faster.
Survive the chaos and you are rewarded: all points are worth 5× while a prank is active.

480953.overview: A short text adventure for the Commodore 64 set in the world of the Gold Quest game series. Has modes for both German and English language play.

480993.overview: Tablut is a traditional Scandinavian and Saami board game from the tafl family, the same family as Hnefatafl which was played by the Vikings over 1000 years ago. It was written down by Carl Linnaeus in 1732 and is the version of the game for which we have the most complete historical rules. A king and eight defenders face sixteen attackers on a 9x9 board.

481718.overview: Epic space battle for the destiny of Earth!

481812.overview: TRICKY TRIO! is a fun and challenging C64 game! Watch carefully as three objects are shuffled around. Keep your eyes on the target, follow the moves, and make the right choice. Can you beat the shuffle?

481821.overview: The gameplay is untouched. Traffic flow, timing, levels and scoring work just like the original. Every change was checked step by step against the original game so that the cars go exactly where they always did. The one exception is a fix for a bug in the original game that could block a lane for the rest of a stage, which could have caused the inability to complete the level (see Fixes below).

482205.overview: A cinematic infiltration puzzle game for the Commodore 64, in the spirit of Impossible Mission and Paradroid. You have broken into TITAN, an automated missile launch complex run by robots. The launch countdown is already running. Take over the robots from the complex's own terminals and use them to stop the launch before the clock reaches zero.

482533.overview:
Despite the game's name, Turbo Ski for the C64 is NOT a sports/skiing game. It is actually a 1-player-only pseudo-3D shooter that borrows from games like the 1984 game "Stealth" and, to a lesser degree, the Buck Rogers arcade game.

The game was developed by Bob Blackmer and published by Ion International as part of Ahoy! 1988/09 (Issue #57).

482755.overview: As a child, I was a huge fan of Thorsten Woelki’s Tennis-Manager. When I rediscovered the game a while back, I thought it would be fun to play it using current ATP data. This evolved into a complete redesign with new features, built upon the original BASIC code.

482769.overview: TEMPLE OF EMBERS is a brand-new platformer for the Commodore 64, written in pure 6502 assembly. Chunky pixel art, dithered night skies, a yellow crescent moon and big, expressive monsters - all squeezed into 64 KB and 16 colors.

482913.overview: Turn the pipes. Keep the ball rolling.
